We'll send absolute time stamps in invites to avoid confusion.

We can do two practical options next week (all times shown with both local labels):
- Option A: Tuesday 5 Oct, 07:30 CEST / 22:30 PDT (late for the US, early for EU engineers) — short live demo + 20 min Q&A
- Option B: Wednesday 6 Oct, 09:00 CEST / 00:00 PDT (a bit late for Seattle; only if their execs can stretch)

If those don't work, we can do a recorded demo (we'll send a ~25 min walkthrough) and follow with a 30-min focused overlap session for questions.

I've attached a provisional calendar invite (twilight-bridge-invite.ics) for Option A so you can quickly check local times. I'll let Kimberly (EU eng) and Jordan (solutions) weigh in on availability.

Cheers,
